task_description: Build the Offline Quran Progress Tracker Desktop Application from scratch using Electron, SQLite, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. The app tracks Quran memorization progress for students, supports teacher/class organization, multiple progress views, reporting, import/export, and backup - all fully offline with Arabic-first RTL UI.

verification.summary: All 115 tests pass across 7 test suites. Tests cover database schema/seeding, student CRUD, level management, progress tracking, Excel export/import with merge+replace modes, and backup operations. Code review findings (XSS, transaction safety, backup correctness, restore flow, progress calculation, IPC validation) have been addressed.
